home.subtitle: Reckless driving, overcharging, harassment? Report it in minutes with photos and a map pin, then track what happens next with your receipt ID.
home.heroAlt: Aerial view of buses and traffic at a busy city intersection
home.quickTrackText: Enter your receipt ID to see where it stands.
home.howTitle: From what you saw to what was done about it.
home.step1Text: Tell us the bus, the route and what happened. Add photos, video and a map pin if you have them.
home.step2Text: You receive a receipt ID straight away, plus a PDF copy by email if you leave your address.
home.step3Text: Our team reviews it, escalates it to the operator or authorities, and you see each update.
home.categoriesTitle: If it made your ride unsafe or unfair, it counts.
home.categoriesText: Every report is categorised and routed to the people who can act on it. Repeat offenders are flagged automatically.
home.commendTitle: Had a great ride? Say so.
home.commendText: A careful driver or a kind conductor deserves to hear it. Commend them in under a minute and we pass it on to the operator.
home.closingTitle: Your report is evidence. Let's make it count.
home.closingText: Patterns across reports show operators and authorities exactly where things go wrong.

about.title: Driving better commutes, together.
about.subtitle: We believe every voice matters in shaping a more efficient, safer and friendlier public transport system.
about.missionText: Our mission is to give daily commuters a simple tool to report, track and influence the quality of public bus services. By bridging the gap between passengers and transport authorities, we aim for a transparent, responsive network where feedback turns into real improvements.
about.visionText: We envision public transport that is consistently excellent, comfortable and reliable, with BusWatch as the leading platform for passenger advocacy and continuous improvement, driven by the insights of the community it serves.
about.safetyText: Helping identify and fix hazards before someone gets hurt.
about.punctualityText: Pinpointing skipped halts and missed schedules for more reliable service.
about.qualityText: Encouraging higher standards of vehicle maintenance and professionalism.
about.accessibilityText: Surfacing the challenges faced by passengers with disabilities.
about.communityText: Giving every commuter a voice that is recorded and followed up.
about.ctaText: Seen something on a bus? Your report is the first step.
about.contactText: We'd love to hear from you.

impact.subtitle: Every number on this page comes from reports passengers sent and our team checked. Totals only: no names, no receipts, no exact times.
